noPriceRecord: None of the selected parts has a price record.
missingCount: {count, plural, one {# part has no price} other {# parts have no price}} and did not enter the total.
unconvertibleCount: {count, plural, one {# part's currency} other {# parts' currencies}} could not be converted and did not enter the total.
rateNoteManual: Prices are converted from {source} using a manually entered rate: 1 {source} = {rate} ({date}). This is not a live rate.
coverageNote: Only on some parts and from a single source. The source publishes {source}; the screen shows {target} using a manually entered rate

upgrade.heading: Upgrade suggestion
upgrade.needsMeasurement: The upgrade suggestion also relies on performance data. Until measurements are collected we cannot give an honest answer to "what does this money improve, and by how much".
upgrade.needsParts: A suggestion needs a processor and a graphics card first — otherwise there is nothing to measure the gain against.
upgrade.enterBudget: Enter an extra budget and we will look for what it can buy.
upgrade.nothingFound: No change within this budget improves the index.

saved.frozenHeading: Values at the time of saving
saved.totalNotFrozen: The total price was not frozen.
saved.totalNotFrozenWhy: At least one part in this build had no price when it was saved. A total built from incomplete prices would have looked cheaper than reality, and being frozen it could never be corrected; so it was never written.
saved.frozenCurrencyNote: The frozen value is in {currency} and does not change; the {target} figure above was calculated with today's rate.
saved.todayIncomplete: Some parts have no current price, so today's total cannot be calculated.
saved.todayNote: This figure is for information; it does not replace the frozen total above.
saved.intro: Saved on {date}. Frozen values belong to that day; the boxes with a dashed border are calculated from today's data.
saved.frozenIndexNote: Calculated for {resolution} with engine version {modelVersion}. This is not a claim about real frame rates.
saved.noIndexTitle: There is not enough data for a performance estimate.
saved.noIndexWhy: This build was saved with {resolution} selected. The index requires both a graphics card and a processor, and requires measurement data for both; that condition was not met at the moment it was saved. The build is valid — only a number about its speed could not be produced.
saved.todayFpsNote: This list is not frozen: it was calculated with today's measurement data and engine version {modelVersion}. The system index above froze on {date}. Because measurement data only ever grows by addition, these numbers can change over time.
